_comment: T12.38: the words of a meeting deletion that cannot go now, by refusal. Rust's deletion.rs and the UI's one copy (shell/deleteCopy.ts, read by the delete question and the mock) say them; both suites check against this table, so a copy change edits it.
recording: This meeting is still recording. Stop the recording first, then delete the meeting.
finishing: This meeting is still being finished. Delete it again to stop that work and delete the meeting.
still_stopping: Earshot is still stopping the work on this meeting, so it was not deleted yet. Try again in a minute.
needs_restart: Earshot could not stop earlier work on this meeting, and that work still holds it. Restart Earshot, then delete the meeting.
retranscribing: This meeting is being transcribed again. Delete it when that has finished.
resummarising: This meeting is being summarised again. Delete it when that has finished.
